name: carbon-consumption-estimated
description: Estimate the energy, CO₂ and water of your Claude Code usage with the EcoLogits method: live in the status line, and per day, month and model with /carbon.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto, en or nl. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale.

zone.title: Electricity mix
zone.description: Whose electricity mix to count CO₂ and water with. USA is where EcoLogits places Anthropic's data centres; WOR is the world average.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show this session's estimated energy and CO₂ in the status line.
